stop_reason.reason: Recorded plan lacks optimizer comparisons; save and repair required.

score_tradeoff_all_decisions.meaning: per decision and body: objective = goal part + strength part (+ parts reading 0 here); first = the search start (the motor controller's command, the first proposal); selected = the command the search selected; d_ = selected - first

gate4_in_run_s4_search.meaning: gate 4's in-run reading of the s4 search (repair arm): trust_region_used per body (0 = the first proposal kept; 1 = the bounded step's edge; above 1.0001 = the search's own rule broken) and selected_fraction (0, 0.25, 0.5, 1 of the bounded step). The response to a 0.00001 token change is not read here.
gate4_in_run_s4_search.goal_distance_by_sense_meaning: the s4 search record's own predicted per-sense goal distance (acting route), selected command minus the motor controller's command; below 0 = the search predicted that sense nearer the goal

forecast_error_all_commands.meaning: body-averaged as causal_chain.jsonl stores them (mean squared distance between forecast and actual raw tokens per sense, mean over bodies): learning route = raw tokens; acting route = the planner's depth-one forecast on top-down-gated tokens; ratio = forecast error / persistence error (0 exact, 1 no better than 'nothing changes'); actual raw tokens follow the optimizer's update, so encoder change is inside these errors

forecast_error_captured.meaning: THE CAPTURE, per body. forecast_vector_mse: the capture's mean over the token's numbers of (forecast tokens - actual tokens) squared (depth-one forecast against raw and against acting tokens one model step later; raw-route forecast against raw tokens one model step later and at the hold end). signed_goal_distance_error: forecast distance to the selected goal minus observed distance. Raw across weight versions = observation + encoder change; acting includes the model's own forecasts (not independent actual success).

score_tradeoff_captured.meaning: per decision and body: objective = goal part + strength part (+ parts reading 0 here); first = the search start (the motor controller's command, the first proposal); selected = the command the search selected; d_ = selected - first

physical_from_capture.meaning: the capture's achieved handle state (cm): mean over 25 body handles of |position - goal pose position| and both wrists, at the plan step, one model step later and the hold end; progress = start minus hold end (above 0 = nearer at the hold end); excluded where the goal pose was not stored
physical_from_capture.exact_body_command_match_meaning: body-command matching only: the executed body rows equal the planned ones in every burst; never proof that the whole sensory forecast is attributable
physical_from_capture.caveat: live samples: each command starts from the arm's own state toward its own selected earlier pose, so this describes the run and explains individual commands; it is not the frozen same-start ability comparison, and a difference of averages cannot establish learned reaching improvement

contacts_from_capture.meaning: the capture's contact report over the hold: measured false, a null count or a flag not reported by every burst reads unknown, never 'no contact'

command_links_from_capture.meaning: cm and degrees, per captured command and body: 0 = the same command; planned = the depth-one executed form the planner predicted from, sent = the command handed to the body, executed = the first burst the world executed; per column the largest |a - b| over the 25 body rows, the eye row apart (its executed form is the eyes' realised angle, so it differs by design)

s4_search_terms_captured.meaning: the s4 search record's predicted per-sense goal distance (acting route), selected command minus the motor controller's command, for the captured commands; below 0 = predicted nearer

observer_captured_commands.meaning: observer join: distances to the selected earlier pose from forward kinematics of saved qpos (world frame, as render_saved.py's exact trace): progress = distance at the actual start - distance at the hold end (above 0 = nearer at the hold end)
observer_captured_commands.caveat: live samples: each command starts from the arm's own state toward its own selected earlier pose, so this describes the run and explains individual commands; it is not the frozen same-start ability comparison, and a difference of averages cannot establish learned reaching improvement

disagreement_captured.meaning: counts per captured command and body: frozen proprioception nearer = its goal distance lower at the hold end than at the start; predicted improvement = the selected objective below the first proposal's; physical nearer = the observer's 15-handle mean distance to the earlier pose lower at the hold end than at the start. The capture's own raw-sum labels are in physical_from_capture.agreement_labels

same_state_check_inputs.meaning: what a later focused same-state check would start from (the overseer: preserved, no job launched automatically): the arm's checkpoints and, per usable captured command, the capture's saved state key and identities
